MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 23
   D. 19

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 18

5. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

6. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 144

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

11. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 1

12. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 11
   C. 25
   D. 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME

1. B — 17
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 8² + 15²
3. c² = 64 + 225
4. c² = 289
5. c = 17
Final Answer: 17 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

2. D — 49

2. Substitute values: 7² = 7 × 7

Final Answer: 49
